text:
Jordan: quick sketch: split failure surfaces for multi-region into control-plane leases, inference data-plane, and compliance/audit fanout. putting diagram in drive: https://redwood/internal/multisite/failure_map.png
Maya: nice. do you want a proto + runbook strawman?
Jordan: yes. proto for lease: LeaseAcquire(tenant_id, preferred_site, ttl) -> LeaseToken(site, expires_at). idempotency required.
Liam: active/active with primary-affinity by default? or active/passive for some tenants?
Jordan: default active/active + client header hints. offer tenant-level "local-only" to pin writes. active/passive only for explicit opt-in.
Sara: residency note: for residency-locked tenants raw logs and write telemetry must not leave region. fanout must be selective.
Nina: observability: traces need site tag + residency flag and a cross-site span-id to join fallbacks. metric: cross_site_failover{tenant,from,to,reason}.
Ethan: operator play: overload circuit -> for residency tenants return 429+residency-route header. for others failover. add preflight: no migrations in last 15m before a cutover.
Liam: cache warming: async pre-warm popular prefixes on detected steady-state shift. residency tenants: only mirror metadata/consent-stamp, never raw payloads.
Jordan: tests: chaos site kill, burst traffic, compliance sim (EU tenant). include conflict appendix: inference=idem, metadata=CRDT/merge, billing=append-only.
